title: Can every symmetric matrix take a root?
hook: Can every symmetric matrix take a root? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Arithmetic, function evaluation, vector dot products, small matrices and solving linear equations.
doesNotKnow: Factor a symmetric positive-definite matrix while rejecting a nonpositive pivot.

misconception: Every symmetric matrix has a real Cholesky factorization.
objective: Factor a symmetric positive-definite matrix while rejecting a nonpositive pivot.

claims.text: Each diagonal square root uses the remaining positive pivot after previous-column contributions are removed. Symmetry alone is insufficient: the contrasting matrix produces a nonpositive pivot and the algorithm rejects it.
